speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development whether the Ministry will consider reviewing the income criteria for the Student Care Fee Assistance to reduce out-of-pocket Student Care Centre fee expenses.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Out-of-pocket fees vary, depending on families' household income and the SCC that they enrol their children in.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: The Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) reviews the SCFA from time to time to ensure that student care fees remain affordable for those who need help and will continue to do so.

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: I would just like to ask the hon Senior Parliamentary Secretary: because student care operators are likely to face cost pressures, does MSF anticipate that student care fees would actually inch up and would MSF be prepared to increase the quantum for support in the coming years?

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: The second supplementary question is: for families which have more than one child, the family expenses do not increase proportionately.

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: So, will MSF consider stepped-up assistance for child two onwards?

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: Thirdly, I understand that student care assistance schemes do not extend to enrichment programmes in student care.

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: Would MSF look into supporting, especially children from resource-low families, in terms of the fees for enrichment programmes to promote a more inclusive learning environment in after school care?

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: So, rest assured that we do review this scheme.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: So, we do take quite a varied approach in helping families where the needs are most prescient.
